slides.texte_overlay:
5 strange hobbies that make
your brain work like a genius

memorising poems

learn one short poem by heart every month. it trains your memory like a muscle, and having a few beautiful lines ready to share is always a lovely surprise.

mental maths

add up your shopping in your head before you reach the till. a few minutes of mental maths a day keeps your brain quick and makes numbers feel far less scary.

studying odd topics

spend 5 minutes a day on a topic you'd never normally touch: geology, opera, ancient law. new topics build new connections in your brain that nothing else can.
slides.texte_sophia:
studying odd topics

i spend 5 minutes a day on a topic i'd never touch, like geology or opera. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and my brain makes connections it never made before.

slides.texte_overlay:
drawing maps from memory

after visiting somewhere new, draw a map of it from memory. it trains your spatial memory and makes you notice so much more every single time you go out.

playing strategy games

play one strategy game a week with friends, like chess or go. thinking several moves ahead trains the same calm, careful logic you use to make good decisions.
